nuggets.text: The Seahawks won the 1987 NCAA Division III national title, beating Dayton 19-3 in the championship game.
The Seahawks play on Hameline Field, named for Walt Hameline, who coached them to the 1987 national title.
Head coach Tom Masella, a Staten Island native, was a team captain on the Seahawks' 9-1 squad of 1981.
Benjamin Newman threw three touchdown passes in his first career start as the Seahawks beat Southern Connecticut State 31-7.
Saturday's game is the first-ever football meeting between the Seahawks and James Madison.
The Seahawks face two FBS opponents this season for the sixth straight year and the ninth time overall.
The Seahawks opened this season with a conference game for the first time since 2001.
The Seahawks' home stadium opened in 1967 as Fischer Memorial Field and did not add lights until 2013.
The Seahawks went a perfect 4-0 in ECAC Bowls, playing in 1983, 1985, 1986 and 1992.
The Seahawks piled up 409 yards and held the ball for more than 33 minutes in last week's 31-7 win.
